note: Bighorn NF campground in lodgepole pine just south of Sibley Lake, 0.4 mi off US-14 (Bighorn Scenic Byway) near Burgess Junction; run by a concessionaire. The electric loop is the only one on the forest. --Claude
summary: FS and rec.gov current. 24 sites (catalog; stored 25), 14 electric (30 A, two 50 A) in the west loop, 4 RV sites + 1 tent site first-come, $20.50/$25.50 on rec.gov ($23/$28 on FS), 14-day limit, Jun 11 - Sep 20 2027. Not waterfront stands. PIN MOVE ~340 m. Phone empty -> 307-431-7446.
